taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: A shrub: Polygonaceae has no shrub form of its own, so it grows on the angiosperms' broadleaf shrub, as the template does.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Eriogonum fasciculatum var. polifolium: shrubs or subshrubs, compact to spreading, 2-5(-8) x 2-20(-30) dm (the desert variety, var. polifolium).

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Eriogonum fasciculatum var. polifolium: 2-5(-8) dm; Kearney and Peebles (1942 p. 252): a xerophilous shrub up to about 1 m (3 feet) high.

traits.life_span.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Eriogonum fasciculatum: shrubs or subshrubs.

traits.woodiness.note: Kearney and Peebles, Flowering Plants and Ferns of Arizona (1942) p. 252, Eriogonum fasciculatum: var. polifolium, a xerophilous shrub up to about 1 m.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Eriogonum fasciculatum: leaves cauline, 1 per node or fasciculate.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Eriogonum fasciculatum var. polifolium: leaf blade usually oblanceolate, 0.6-1.8 x (0.1-)0.2-0.6 cm.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Eriogonum fasciculatum var. polifolium: leaf blade 0.6-1.8 x (0.1-)0.2-0.6 cm.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Eriogonum fasciculatum: petiole 0.1-0.3 cm, canescent.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Eriogonum fasciculatum var. polifolium: leaf blade usually oblanceolate.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Eriogonum fasciculatum var. polifolium: margins plane or infrequently revolute, not toothed.

traits.leaf_hairs.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Eriogonum fasciculatum var. polifolium: canescent on both surfaces or densely grayish-tomentose abaxially and canescent adaxially.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Eriogonum fasciculatum var. polifolium: inflorescences capitate to cymose-umbellate, rarely cymose; Kearney and Peebles (1942 p. 252): involucres in dense headlike clusters. Drawn as a compact umbel.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: each headlike cluster 1 cm to 3 cm across, as in the photos.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: 20 to 60 flowers in a cluster, from 3 to 8 involucres (FNA) of several flowers each.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Eriogonum fasciculatum: flowers 2.5-3 mm.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Eriogonum fasciculatum: perianth white to pinkish; Kearney and Peebles (1942 p. 252): whitish or pinkish, slightly fragrant flowers; sRGB by eye from the photos.

traits.fruit_type.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Eriogonum fasciculatum: achenes light brown to brown, 1.8-2.5 mm, glabrous.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Eriogonum fasciculatum: achenes 1.8-2.5 mm.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Eriogonum fasciculatum: achenes light brown to brown; sRGB by eye.

traits.flowering_months.note: Kearney and Peebles, Flowering Plants and Ferns of Arizona (1942) p. 252, Eriogonum fasciculatum: on dry rocky slopes, March to June; FNA, var. polifolium: flowering year-round.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: achenes ripe May to August, the dried rusty heads staying on the plant.

generator.params.note: Set by hand for California buckwheat: a compact, many-stemmed rounded shrub (fork_stems 12) of spreading branches (branch_angle 45); the rest of its growth comes from the angiosperms' broadleaf shrub defaults and rules from its height and leaves.

appearance.note: By eye, from the photos the traits cite: a compact, rounded shrub of many slender branches crowded with small grey-green oblanceolate leaves in bunches, topped with dense round clusters of tiny whitish-pink flowers. Colours set by eye were written as screen (sRGB) shades; they are read as the linear light a colour field holds, and bark and foliage follow the stated colour traits by rule (2026-10-19).

allometry.note: 0.4 m tall at 10 years in the open, within its sources' range, as grown. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.
